description: Deposit into a PRIVATE balance on the chosen Gloam network. Mints a note, generates the Groth16 shield proof server-side with that network's keys, and broadcasts shieldBound() (approving the ERC-20 first when the asset is a token). On mainnet the pool takes USDG or GLOAM on Robinhood Chain and USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0 or OUSD on Tempo, at most 500 of a stablecoin (25,000 GLOAM) per deposit during the beta; deposits are free. The note's secret stays inside this server; the agent gets a note handle to pay from later (gloam_execute_private_pay, gloam_list_notes). Requires GLOAM_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY; without it, returns a plan.

amount.description: Amount to shield into a private balance, in the asset's units (e.g. 25 for 25 USDC.e).

asset.description: ERC-20 token address to shield; omit to use the network default (USDG on Robinhood Chain mainnet, USDC.e on Tempo mainnet, USDC on Base and Ethereum, PathUSD on Tempo testnet, native ETH on Robinhood Chain testnet). On Base and Ethereum, the zero address shields ETH.

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset; omit to use the asset's own (6 for the stablecoins, 18 for GLOAM and ETH).

network.description: Which network to shield on: "robinhood-mainnet", "tempo-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "ethereum-mainnet", "robinhood", "tempo", "base", "ethereum". The -mainnet ones are the mainnets (beta deposit limits); "robinhood", "tempo", "base" and "ethereum" are the testnets. Default here: "robinhood".

name: gloam_execute_shield
title: Execute a private shield
